name: NeRF-OSR
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields for Outdoor Scene Relighting
definition: NeRF-OSR is a neural radiance fields approach for outdoor scene relighting that learns a neural representation of scene geometry, diffuse albedo, and illumination-dependent shadows from a set of images capturing the same site from different viewpoints and at different times, enabling simultaneous editing of both the scene’s lighting and viewpoint.
